FN-PWYIERE-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 86
Committee: Finance & Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: Cary Dean Date: 02/05/2025
Senate Bill 86 as introduced could reduce income tax receipts to the Education Trust Fund by
an undetermined amount dependent upon the new income tax deductions allowed for
contributions to portable benefits accounts for independent contractors established pursuant to
the provisions of this bill.
This bill provides that deductions shall be equal to 100% of the amount contributed by an
independent contractor or by a a hiring party as a form of compensation, to a portable benefit
accounts.

FN-PWYIERE-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 86
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: Cary Dean Date: 03/17/2025
Senate Bill 86 as passed the Senate could reduce income tax receipts, beginning in Fiscal Year
2027, to the Education Trust Fund by an undetermined amount dependent upon: (1) the amount
of contributions to portable benefits accounts for independent contractors, which would be
fully-deductible from state income tax, pursuant to the provisions of this bill; and (2) the
applicable effective income tax rate of the taxpayer claiming the deduction.
